_note: A payment or deposit by an individual, as parent or guardian, to the account of a minor under the notified pension scheme: s.124(4) allows the deduction under s.124(3) for it, "subject to the condition that the aggregate amount of deduction under sub-section (3) and this sub-section shall not exceed ₹50000" (Gazette 265620, p.160). Not a Schedule XV sum. D-130.
displayName: Pension System deposit for a minor

provenance.sourceDescription: Gazette CG-DL-E-22082025-265620, Income-tax Act, 2025 s.124(4), p.160
